# Docs Assist

> A Claude Code plugin that coaches subject matter experts through writing documentation.
> It gives Claude Code documentation expertise: guiding contributors through knowledge extraction, picking the right content structure, applying writing standards, and connecting new docs to existing content.

## Docs

- [Set Up Documentation Standards for Your Team](docs/set-up-documentation-standards-for-your-team.md): For docs leads and devrel. Why to install, what changes for contributors, and how to customize.
- [Write Docs With Docs Assist](docs/write-docs-with-docs-assist.md): For individual contributors. What the plugin does, and tips for getting the most out of it.
- [Docs Assist Command Reference](docs/command-reference.md): Every command with its argument and an example.

## Plugin Configuration

- [SKILL.md](skills/docs-assist/SKILL.md): Core instructions that shape how Claude Code behaves during documentation tasks.
- [Plugin manifest](.claude-plugin/plugin.json): Plugin metadata, version, and registered commands.
- [Marketplace manifest](.claude-plugin/marketplace.json): Marketplace metadata used to install the plugin.

## Commands

- [/docs-assist:draft](commands/draft.md): Guided workflow for SMEs to contribute a single document.
- [/docs-assist:plan](commands/plan.md): Plan a full documentation set: user journeys, content types, priorities, and writing order.
- [/docs-assist:health](commands/health.md): Fast docs health check: a scorecard across coverage, freshness, consistency, and findability, plus the single highest-leverage fix. The recommended first command.
- [/docs-assist:audit](commands/audit.md): Systematic documentation audit for quality, gaps, and structure.
- [/docs-assist:make-examples](commands/make-examples.md): Add or improve code examples in existing docs.
- [/docs-assist:init](commands/init.md): Scaffold project-local configuration so the plugin and the linters share one source of truth.
- [/docs-assist:setup-lint](commands/setup-lint.md): Scaffold optional documentation linting (Vale, markdownlint, MegaLinter, cspell, link check), generated from the project config and respecting any existing linter.
- [/docs-assist:setup-hooks](commands/setup-hooks.md): Install opt-in documentation hooks (git pre-commit lint, in-session doc lint, CI docs-impact check). Default off.
- [/docs-assist:update](commands/update.md): Find and update the docs affected by a code change (a diff, a PR, or changed files).
- [/docs-assist:release-notes](commands/release-notes.md): Turn a release's worth of changes into reader-facing release notes, leading with breaking changes and upgrade steps.
- [/docs-assist:agent-ready](commands/agent-ready.md): Make the docs legible to AI tools: create or repair llms.txt, complete frontmatter, record conventions.
- [/docs-assist:template](commands/template.md): Suggest and scaffold a documentation template (The Good Docs Project) for a healthy start. Opt-in.

## Agents

- [doc-auditor](agents/doc-auditor.md): Audits a single doc or slice and returns structured findings. Used to fan out large audits in parallel.
- [doc-updater](agents/doc-updater.md): Updates a single doc to match a code change. Used to fan out update-on-change across many files.
- [doc-intake](agents/doc-intake.md): Reads a pile of raw source material in isolation and returns a compact content inventory. Used to fan out corpus intake without loading the pile into the main conversation.
- [doc-recon](agents/doc-recon.md): Reads a codebase in isolation and returns a compact project map (what it does, features, entry points, audiences, candidate docs). Used to orient a from-scratch docs effort without reading the whole repo in the main conversation.

## Standards and Methodology

- [Knowledge intake](skills/docs-assist/reference/intake.md): Gather before you structure. The dump-first intake loop for one doc, and the corpus content-inventory method for from-scratch work.
- [Content types](skills/docs-assist/reference/content-types.md): The canonical content types and their frontmatter values. The single source of truth.
- [Frontmatter spec](skills/docs-assist/reference/frontmatter-spec.md): Schema for per-doc metadata: fields, tiers, and how the plugin uses them.
- [Tone and voice](skills/docs-assist/reference/tone-and-voice.md): Formatting rules, heading case, markdown style, and voice guidelines.
- [Code examples](skills/docs-assist/reference/code-examples.md): Write safe code samples that stay consistent across docs, using a plugin-maintained example-variables registry.
- [Terminology](skills/docs-assist/reference/terminology.md): Keep product terms consistent across docs, using a plugin-maintained terms registry that audits check for drift.
- [Config resolution](skills/docs-assist/reference/config-resolution.md): How a project's committed `.docs-assist/` configuration overrides the defaults and feeds the linters.
- [Documentation patterns](skills/docs-assist/reference/documentation-patterns.md): Patterns, antipatterns, examples, SEO, and accessibility.
- [Templates](skills/docs-assist/reference/templates.md): Suggest and apply external documentation templates (The Good Docs Project) for a healthy start. Opt-in, with content-type and seven-action selection.

## For Docs Leads

- [Audit methodology](skills/docs-assist/reference/audit-methodology.md): Systematic audit process for docs leads.
- [Impact analysis](skills/docs-assist/reference/impact-analysis.md): Scope a change-based audit or update. Maps each change type to the edges it can break, with a traversal budget and residual-risk reporting.
- [IA methodology](skills/docs-assist/reference/ia-methodology.md): Information architecture research, design, and validation.
- [Style guides](skills/docs-assist/reference/style-guides.md): Style guide selection, components, and enforcement strategies.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): How to contribute to this plugin.
- [0.8.0 product review findings](docs/reviews/0.8.0-findings.md): The prioritized findings behind the 0.8.0 release, with the remaining recommendations.
